confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge and supplied comparables; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant anchors are the most grounded (Cebu-calibrated with a Manila uplift). Hostel and hotel bands are wide because Manila varies sharply by district, and the 3-star anchor is least certain. Cocktail and wine are weakly grounded and were set relative to the beer anchor (about 2.6 to 2.7 times draught beer). FX value came from RBA search-result snippets, not a direct page read; the 15 Oct 2026 figure appeared in only one snapshot with an inconsistent age label, while 13 and 14 Oct were corroborated, so verify the 15 Oct value before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Cebu (same country) anchors restaurant prices, with an uplift for Manila's higher urban prices. Penang and Yogyakarta anchor the hostel and hotel bands: private hostel room about 2 to 3 times the dorm bed, and 3-star room about 2.1 to 2.4 times the basic hotel room; Manila's 3-star is set slightly above that ratio for business-hotel pricing. Beer, cocktail and wine are linked by a beer-relative multiple.
